title: Burden
description: Versatile storage that burdens the Player
body:
# Burden
> ### Disclaimer
> This mod is currently in alpha and doesn't include all features yet!
> If you encounter any issues, please report them on the issue tracker.
## About
Burden add backpacks to the game that :
- Can be accessed when in either hand by right-clicking
- Can be accessed when equipped by pressing keybind (by default B)
- Curios compatibility is supported, backpack can be equipped in Curios' back slot instead
- Can be placed on ground by shift right-clicking
- Can be crafted in colored variants with colored wools
- Can be colored with colored dyes and cleaned with water cauldron
## Development
This mod is incomplete for now. Burden aims to add a full portable storage experience by adding backpack extensions, weight feature, and so one.
## Localization
Burden is currently available in English (en_us) and French (fr_fr).
